title: अनेरास्ववियुलाई प्रालि बनाइयो, सच्चिने बाटो छोडेर सकिनेतर्फ नेतृत्व !
content:
अनेरास्ववियु केवल एउटा विद्यार्थी सङ्गठन मात्र होइन, यो हजारौँ विद्यार्थीको आशा, विश्वास, त्याग, समर्पण र राजनीतिक चेतनाको प्रतिनिधित्व गर्ने ऐतिहासिक सङ्गठन हो । यस सङ्गठनको गौरवशाली इतिहास, स्थापित मूल्य–मान्यता र सङ्गठनात्मक पद्धतिको संरक्षण गर्नु नेतृत्वमा रहेका प्रत्येक व्यक्तिको दायित्व हो । तर पछिल्लो समय सङ्गठनभित्र कमिटीबाट बिदाइ, जिम्मेवारी हेरफेर तथा मनोनयनसम्बन्धी विषयमा भएका निर्णयहरूले सङ्गठनात्मक विधि, सामूहिक नेतृत्व र निर्णय प्रक्रियाको परिपक्वतामाथि गम्भीर प्रश्न उठाएका छन् । सङ्गठन सञ्चालनका क्रममा जिम्मेवारी परिवर्तन हुनु, नयाँ साथीहरूलाई अवसर दिनु वा आवश्यकताअनुसार कमिटी पुनर्गठन गर्नु अस्वाभाविक होइन । तर यस्ता निर्णय निश्चित विधि, स्पष्ट आधार, संस्थागत छलफल र सङ्गठनको बृहत्तर हितलाई केन्द्रमा राखेर गरिनुपर्छ । निर्णयको औचित्य, प्रक्रिया र त्यसले सङ्गठनमा पार्ने प्रभावबारे पर्याप्त छलफल नै नगरी गरिने निर्णयले सङ्गठनलाई बलियो होइन, कमजोर बनाउँछ । मेरो असहमति जिम्मेवारी परिवर्तनसँग मात्र होइन, निर्णय गर्ने प्रक्रियासँग हो । अनेरास्ववियुको केन्द्रीय सदस्य एवं सुनसरी जिल्ला इन्चार्जको हैसियतले पछिल्लो समय भएका कमिटीबाट बिदाइ, जिम्मेवारी हेरफेर तथा मनोनयनसम्बन्धी निर्णयप्रति मेरो गम्भीर असहमति रहेको स्पष्ट पार्न चाहन्छु । यी निर्णयहरू पर्याप्त संस्थागत छलफल, परिपक्वता र सङ्गठनात्मक औचित्यका आधारमा नभई आगामी महाधिवेशनको तयारीस्वरूप अघि बढाइएको मेरो ठहर छ । सङ्गठनको जीवनमा दूरगामी प्रभाव पार्नसक्ने यस्ता विषयमा सम्बन्धित पक्षको धारणा, सङ्गठनात्मक अवस्था र स्थापित पद्धतिलाई बेवास्ता गर्नु उचित हुन सक्दैन । कुनै पनि निर्णयको वैधानिकता त्यसमा हस्ताक्षर गर्ने व्यक्ति वा पदको आधारमा मात्र स्थापित हुँदैन । निर्णयको विश्वसनीयता त्यसको प्रक्रिया, औचित्य, पारदर्शिता र सङ्गठनप्रतिको जबाफदेहिताबाट निर्धारण हुन्छ । सङ्गठनभित्र असहमति राख्ने आवाजलाई कमजोर बनाउने, सरोकारवालासँग पर्याप्त परामर्श नगर्ने र निर्णयलाई एकपक्षीय रूपमा कार्यान्वयन गर्न खोज्ने प्रवृत्तिले सामूहिक नेतृत्वको मर्ममाथि नै प्रहार गर्छ । हामीले बुझ्नुपर्ने कुरा के हो भने सङ्गठन कुनै व्यक्ति वा समूहको निजी सम्पत्ति होइन । यहाँको जिम्मेवारी व्यक्तिगत कृपा वा निकटताका आधारमा बाँडिने विषय पनि होइन । सङ्गठनमा योगदान, क्षमता, विधि र सामूहिक निर्णयको सम्मान हुनुपर्छ। फरक मत राख्नु अनुशासनहीनता होइन, बरु सङ्गठनलाई सही दिशामा अघि बढाउनका लागि तथ्य, विधि र विवेकका आधारमा प्रश्न उठाउनु जिम्मेवार राजनीतिक संस्कार हो । आजको आवश्यकता असहमतिलाई दबाउने होइन, असहमतिको सम्मान गर्दै निर्णयलाई परिमार्जन गर्ने हो । सङ्गठनभित्र उत्पन्न असन्तुष्टिलाई बेवास्ता गरेर वा निर्णय भइसकेको तर्कका आधारमा मात्र त्यसलाई सही साबित गर्न खोजेर समस्याको समाधान हुँदैन । नेतृत्वको परिपक्वता आफूले गरेको निर्णयको बचाउ गर्नु मात्र होइन, गल्ती वा कमजोरी देखिएमा त्यसलाई सच्याउने साहस देखाउनुमा पनि निहित हुन्छ । यसर्थ, अनेरास्ववियुको कमिटीबाट बिदाइ, जिम्मेवारी हेरफेर तथा मनोनयनसम्बन्धी पछिल्ला एकपक्षीय एवं अपरिपक्व निर्णयहरू तत्काल खारेज गर्न, ती निर्णयहरूको पुनरावलोकन गर्न र सङ्गठनको विधि, विधान तथा संस्थागत प्रक्रियाअनुसार सम्बन्धित पक्षसँग पर्याप्त छलफल गरी नयाँ निर्णय लिन म स्पष्ट माग गर्दछु । यो माग कुनै व्यक्ति विशेषप्रतिको पूर्वाग्रह वा व्यक्तिगत असन्तुष्टिबाट प्रेरित होइन । यो सङ्गठनात्मक पद्धति, सामूहिक नेतृत्व र अनेरास्ववियुको संस्थागत गरिमाको रक्षाका लागि उठाइएको आवाज हो । निर्णय प्रक्रियामाथि प्रश्न उठाउनु सुगठनविरुद्ध जानु होइन, गलत प्रक्रियालाई सच्याउन खोज्नु सङ्गठनप्रतिको जिम्मेवारी हो । अन्त्यमा, सम्बन्धित नेतृत्वको गम्भीर ध्यानाकर्षण गराउँदै पछिल्ला निर्णयहरू तत्काल खारेज गरी विधिसम्मत, पारदर्शी र सामूहिक सहमतिमा आधारित निर्णय प्रक्रिया सुनिश्चित गर्न पुनः जोडदार माग गर्दछु । (लेखक अनेरास्ववियुका केन्द्रीय सदस्य एवं सुनसरी जिल्ला इन्चार्ज हुन् ।) ANNFSU is not just a student organization, it is a historical organization that represents the hope, faith, sacrifice, dedication and political consciousness of thousands of students. It is the responsibility of every person in the leadership to protect the glorious history, established values and organizational system of this organization. However, in recent times, decisions made within the organization regarding departures from committees, changes in responsibilities and nominations have raised serious questions about the maturity of organizational methods, collective leadership and decision-making process. It is not unusual for responsibilities to change, new members to be given opportunities, or committees to be reorganized as needed during the course of an organization's operations. However, such decisions should be made with a clear methodology, clear basis, institutional discussion, and the larger interest of the organization in mind. Decisions made without adequate discussion about the rationale, process, and impact of the decision on the organization will weaken the organization, not strengthen it. My disagreement is not just with the change of responsibility, but with the decision-making process. As a central member of ANNFSU and Sunsari District In-charge, I would like to make it clear that I have serious disagreement with the recent decisions regarding dismissals, changes in responsibilities and nominations from committees. I believe that these decisions were taken in preparation for the upcoming general convention rather than on the basis of adequate institutional discussions, maturity and organizational justification. It is not appropriate to ignore the views of the concerned parties, the organizational situation and the established system on such issues that can have a far-reaching impact on the life of the organization. The legitimacy of any decision is not established solely on the basis of the person or position who signs it. The credibility of a decision is determined by its process, justification, transparency, and accountability to the organization. The tendency to weaken dissenting voices within an organization, not to consult adequately with stakeholders, and to unilaterally implement decisions strikes at the very heart of collective leadership. What we need to understand is that an organization is not the private property of any individual or group. The responsibility here is not something to be shared based on personal favors or proximity. There should be respect for contributions, capabilities, methods, and collective decisions in the organization. Having a different opinion is not indiscipline, but raising questions based on facts, methods, and conscience to move the organization in the right direction is a responsible political culture. The need today is not to suppress dissent, but to respect dissent and revise decisions. Problems cannot be solved by ignoring dissent within an organization or by trying to justify it based solely on the logic of a decision that has already been made. The maturity of leadership lies not only in defending one's decisions, but also in showing the courage to correct them if mistakes or weaknesses are noticed. Therefore, I clearly demand that the recent unilateral and immature decisions regarding dismissals, changes in responsibilities, and nominations from the ANNFSU committee be immediately revoked, those decisions be reviewed, and new decisions be taken after adequate discussions with the concerned parties in accordance with the organization's rules, statutes, and institutional processes. This demand is not motivated by prejudice or personal dissatisfaction towards any particular individual. It is a voice raised to protect the organizational system, collective leadership and institutional dignity of ANNFSU. Questioning the decision-making process is not going against the organization, but trying to correct the wrong process is a responsibility towards the organization. Finally, I once again strongly demand that the relevant leadership be drawn to the serious attention of the concerned leadership to immediately rescind the recent decisions and ensure a decision-making process based on due process, transparency, and collective consensus. (The writer is a central member of ANNFSU and Sunsari district in-charge.)

सुनिश्चित गर्न पुनः जोडदार माग गर्दछु । (लेखक अनेरास्ववियुका केन्द्रीय सदस्य एवं सुनसरी जिल्ला इन्चार्ज हुन् ।)

अनेरास्ववियु केवल एउटा विद्यार्थी सङ्गठन मात्र होइन, यो हजारौँ विद्यार्थीको आशा, विश्वास, त्याग, समर्पण र राजनीतिक चेतनाको प्रतिनिधित्व गर्ने ऐतिहासिक सङ्गठन हो । यस सङ्गठनको गौरवशाली इतिहास, स्थापित मूल्य–मान्यता र सङ्गठनात्मक पद्धतिको संरक्षण गर्नु नेतृत्वमा रहेका प्रत्येक व्यक्तिको दायित्व हो । तर पछिल्लो समय सङ्गठनभित्र कमिटीबाट बिदाइ, जिम्मेवारी हेरफेर तथा मनोनयनसम्बन्धी विषयमा भएका निर्णयहरूले सङ्गठनात्मक विधि, सामूहिक नेतृत्व र निर्णय प्रक्रियाको परिपक्वतामाथि गम्भीर प्रश्न उठाएका छन् ।

सङ्गठन सञ्चालनका क्रममा जिम्मेवारी परिवर्तन हुनु, नयाँ साथीहरूलाई अवसर दिनु वा आवश्यकताअनुसार कमिटी पुनर्गठन गर्नु अस्वाभाविक होइन । तर यस्ता निर्णय निश्चित विधि, स्पष्ट आधार, संस्थागत छलफल र सङ्गठनको बृहत्तर हितलाई केन्द्रमा राखेर गरिनुपर्छ । निर्णयको औचित्य, प्रक्रिया र त्यसले सङ्गठनमा पार्ने प्रभावबारे पर्याप्त छलफल नै नगरी गरिने निर्णयले सङ्गठनलाई बलियो होइन, कमजोर बनाउँछ ।

मेरो असहमति जिम्मेवारी परिवर्तनसँग मात्र होइन, निर्णय गर्ने प्रक्रियासँग हो ।

अनेरास्ववियुको केन्द्रीय सदस्य एवं सुनसरी जिल्ला इन्चार्जको हैसियतले पछिल्लो समय भएका कमिटीबाट बिदाइ, जिम्मेवारी हेरफेर तथा मनोनयनसम्बन्धी निर्णयप्रति मेरो गम्भीर असहमति रहेको स्पष्ट पार्न चाहन्छु । यी निर्णयहरू पर्याप्त संस्थागत छलफल, परिपक्वता र सङ्गठनात्मक औचित्यका आधारमा नभई आगामी महाधिवेशनको तयारीस्वरूप अघि बढाइएको मेरो ठहर छ । सङ्गठनको जीवनमा दूरगामी प्रभाव पार्नसक्ने यस्ता विषयमा सम्बन्धित पक्षको धारणा, सङ्गठनात्मक अवस्था र स्थापित पद्धतिलाई बेवास्ता गर्नु उचित हुन सक्दैन ।

कुनै पनि निर्णयको वैधानिकता त्यसमा हस्ताक्षर गर्ने व्यक्ति वा पदको आधारमा मात्र स्थापित हुँदैन । निर्णयको विश्वसनीयता त्यसको प्रक्रिया, औचित्य, पारदर्शिता र सङ्गठनप्रतिको जबाफदेहिताबाट निर्धारण हुन्छ । सङ्गठनभित्र असहमति राख्ने आवाजलाई कमजोर बनाउने, सरोकारवालासँग पर्याप्त परामर्श नगर्ने र निर्णयलाई एकपक्षीय रूपमा कार्यान्वयन गर्न खोज्ने प्रवृत्तिले सामूहिक नेतृत्वको मर्ममाथि नै प्रहार गर्छ ।

हामीले बुझ्नुपर्ने कुरा के हो भने सङ्गठन कुनै व्यक्ति वा समूहको निजी सम्पत्ति होइन । यहाँको जिम्मेवारी व्यक्तिगत कृपा वा निकटताका आधारमा बाँडिने विषय पनि होइन । सङ्गठनमा योगदान, क्षमता, विधि र सामूहिक निर्णयको सम्मान हुनुपर्छ। फरक मत राख्नु अनुशासनहीनता होइन, बरु सङ्गठनलाई सही दिशामा अघि बढाउनका लागि तथ्य, विधि र विवेकका आधारमा प्रश्न उठाउनु जिम्मेवार राजनीतिक संस्कार हो ।

आजको आवश्यकता असहमतिलाई दबाउने होइन, असहमतिको सम्मान गर्दै निर्णयलाई परिमार्जन गर्ने हो । सङ्गठनभित्र उत्पन्न असन्तुष्टिलाई बेवास्ता गरेर वा निर्णय भइसकेको तर्कका आधारमा मात्र त्यसलाई सही साबित गर्न खोजेर समस्याको समाधान हुँदैन । नेतृत्वको परिपक्वता आफूले गरेको निर्णयको बचाउ गर्नु मात्र होइन, गल्ती वा कमजोरी देखिएमा त्यसलाई सच्याउने साहस देखाउनुमा पनि निहित हुन्छ ।

यसर्थ, अनेरास्ववियुको कमिटीबाट बिदाइ, जिम्मेवारी हेरफेर तथा मनोनयनसम्बन्धी पछिल्ला एकपक्षीय एवं अपरिपक्व निर्णयहरू तत्काल खारेज गर्न, ती निर्णयहरूको पुनरावलोकन गर्न र सङ्गठनको विधि, विधान तथा संस्थागत प्रक्रियाअनुसार सम्बन्धित पक्षसँग पर्याप्त छलफल गरी नयाँ निर्णय लिन म स्पष्ट माग गर्दछु ।

यो माग कुनै व्यक्ति विशेषप्रतिको पूर्वाग्रह वा व्यक्तिगत असन्तुष्टिबाट प्रेरित होइन । यो सङ्गठनात्मक पद्धति, सामूहिक नेतृत्व र अनेरास्ववियुको संस्थागत गरिमाको रक्षाका लागि उठाइएको आवाज हो । निर्णय प्रक्रियामाथि प्रश्न उठाउनु सुगठनविरुद्ध जानु होइन, गलत प्रक्रियालाई सच्याउन खोज्नु सङ्गठनप्रतिको जिम्मेवारी हो ।

अन्त्यमा, सम्बन्धित नेतृत्वको गम्भीर ध्यानाकर्षण गराउँदै पछिल्ला निर्णयहरू तत्काल खारेज गरी विधिसम्मत, पारदर्शी र सामूहिक सहमतिमा आधारित निर्णय प्रक्रिया सुनिश्चित गर्न पुनः जोडदार माग गर्दछु ।

(लेखक अनेरास्ववियुका केन्द्रीय सदस्य एवं सुनसरी जिल्ला इन्चार्ज हुन् ।)

ANNFSU is not just a student organization, it is a historical organization that represents the hope, faith, sacrifice, dedication and political consciousness of thousands of students. It is the responsibility of every person in the leadership to protect the glorious history, established values and organizational system of this organization. However, in recent times, decisions made within the organization regarding departures from committees, changes in responsibilities and nominations have raised serious questions about the maturity of organizational methods, collective leadership and decision-making process. It is not unusual for responsibilities to change, new members to be given opportunities, or committees to be reorganized as needed during the course of an organization's operations. However, such decisions should be made with a clear methodology, clear basis, institutional discussion, and the larger interest of the organization in mind. Decisions made without adequate discussion about the rationale, process, and impact of the decision on the organization will weaken the organization, not strengthen it. My disagreement is not just with the change of responsibility, but with the decision-making process. As a central member of ANNFSU and Sunsari District In-charge, I would like to make it clear that I have serious disagreement with the recent decisions regarding dismissals, changes in responsibilities and nominations from committees. I believe that these decisions were taken in preparation for the upcoming general convention rather than on the basis of adequate institutional discussions, maturity and organizational justification. It is not appropriate to ignore the views of the concerned parties, the organizational situation and the established system on such issues that can have a far-reaching impact on the life of the organization. The legitimacy of any decision is not established solely on the basis of the person or position who signs it. The credibility of a decision is determined by its process, justification, transparency, and accountability to the organization. The tendency to weaken dissenting voices within an organization, not to consult adequately with stakeholders, and to unilaterally implement decisions strikes at the very heart of collective leadership. What we need to understand is that an organization is not the private property of any individual or group. The responsibility here is not something to be shared based on personal favors or proximity. There should be respect for contributions, capabilities, methods, and collective decisions in the organization. Having a different opinion is not indiscipline, but raising questions based on facts, methods, and conscience to move the organization in the right direction is a responsible political culture. The need today is not to suppress dissent, but to respect dissent and revise decisions. Problems cannot be solved by ignoring dissent within an organization or by trying to justify it based solely on the logic of a decision that has already been made. The maturity of leadership lies not only in defending one's decisions, but also in showing the courage to correct them if mistakes or weaknesses are noticed. Therefore, I clearly demand that the recent unilateral and immature decisions regarding dismissals, changes in responsibilities, and nominations from the ANNFSU committee be immediately revoked, those decisions be reviewed, and new decisions be taken after adequate discussions with the concerned parties in accordance with the organization's rules, statutes, and institutional processes. This demand is not motivated by prejudice or personal dissatisfaction towards any particular individual. It is a voice raised to protect the organizational system, collective leadership and institutional dignity of ANNFSU. Questioning the decision-making process is not going against the organization, but trying to correct the wrong process is a responsibility towards the organization. Finally, I once again strongly demand that the relevant leadership be drawn to the serious attention of the concerned leadership to immediately rescind the recent decisions and ensure a decision-making process based on due process, transparency, and collective consensus. (The writer is a central member of ANNFSU and Sunsari district in-charge.)
